flag_block_system.block_labels: three singular points on the selected line
flag_block_system.half_turn_action: fixed-point-free; swaps the two apartment lifts above each selected point-line flag

theorem: The 1620-to-270 apartment map is the homogeneous six-sheet cover G/K -> G/H with |K|=16 and |H|=96. Its local monodromy is D12; the natural 3x2 flag block system quotients D12 to S3, and the kernel is the central half-turn exchanging the two lifts of every point-line flag.
boundary: Finite cover monodromy/selector obstruction only; not an optical or dynamical holonomy.
